introHtml: Pink dog tags make a bold statement for your next event, fundraiser, or team uniform. Whether you need luggage tags for a women’s conference or ID tags for a charity run, this color stands out while keeping your branding front and center. Choose from rectangle or business card insert styles, and add your logo with full-color imprint or laser engraving. Perfect for bulk orders with fast turnaround.
